desc: Get off to an epic start with Cinnamon Toast Crunch Cereal. Every crispy square is blasted with CINNADUST, that irresistible mix of real cinnamon and sugar. Enjoy this crispy, sweetened whole wheat and rice cereal as a ready to eat breakfast food. Simply pour a bowl of cold cereal with milk and dig into that satisfying crunch. Then slurp up the CINNAMILK, the sweet and awesomely tasty cereal milk at the bottom of your bowl. Every serving of this cinnamon cereal provides 16g whole grain (at least 48g recommended daily), 12 vitamins and minerals, and has a good source of calcium. Make it a part of a quick and easy breakfast for teens, kids, and the entire family. Pack some in snack bags and enjoy this crispy cereal on the go. Add it to snack mix or cereal bars recipes for lunchbox snacks. Keep a box in your pantry for mornings or to use as a crispy ice cream topping. You can also sprinkle some cinnamon-y squares over frosted cupcakes and other desserts. Whether you're looking for delicious kids snacks, trail mix ingredients, or a breakfast cereal for everyone in your household, General Mills cereals spread goodness from tots to grown-ups. Contains one cardboard box of crunchy Cinnamon Toast Crunch Breakfast Cereal, Crispy Cinnamon Cereal, Family Size, 18.8 oz; perfect for instant snacking, or a part of breakfast and meals.
